description: Use this when the user wants to add a time entry for work that is already done, instead of using the timer. Takes the project by its name (`project`) or by its ID (`projectId`), so it needs no project_list call first: if the name matches no project or several, nothing is created and the result lists the candidates.

billable.description: Whether this task should be billable to the client. Defaults to project setting.

description.description: Optional description of what work was done

endDateTime.description: Optional end time in ISO 8601 format. If provided, creates a completed task.

project.description: The project's name as the request gives it, such as "Website redesign". A timer or an entry is named after its project: in a request for "the Acme timer", the project is "Acme". Upper and lower case, spaces and hyphens don't have to match. Leave it out when the request names no project. Use this or projectId.

projectId.description: The project's ID, when an earlier result already gave it. Use this or project.

startDateTime.description: When the work started in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-08T09:00:00Z")

name: task_create

action.description: What happened to the task (the rest of the object is the full task)

duration.description: Duration of the task in seconds (if endDateTime was provided)

id.description: The ID of the newly created task

title: Create Task
